description: Official hosted portfolio MCP with 24 tools for holdings, fund overlap, performance explanations, rebalance comparisons, historical stress tests and recorded investment reasoning. Two supplied-holdings tools work anonymously; account tools require OAuth, permissions, enabled sharing and the applicable plan. No order execution or money transfers. Public integration repository: https://github.com/Investboard/ai-toolkit; hosted runtime is private.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http investboard https://app.investboard.com/mcp

notes: analyze_holdings and stress_test_holdings accept supplied holdings without sign-in and read or save nothing in an account.
Account tools require OAuth, appropriate permissions, enabled sharing and the applicable Free or Premium plan. No API key or client environment variables are required.

license: Proprietary (hosted MCP); Apache-2.0 (four companion skills and authored examples)
